findings.correction: That guy really loves it when people recognize his equipment.
findings.current: That guy really loves telling people about his equipment.
findings.defect: 알아봐 주다 is other people recognizing/identifying his gear, not Choi explaining it.
findings.rationale: The beat is Taekyung naming the Red Drake set; Im explains Choi likes being made much of for that, not that he loves giving lectures.
findings.source: 저 친구 장비 알아봐 주는 거 엄청 좋아해.

findings.correction: The Peace Guild is new, so it’s short on people. There are only three of us, including the Guild Master.
findings.current: The Peace Guild is new, so it doesn’t have any members. There are only three of us, including the Guild Master.
findings.defect: 인원이 없어 means they are understaffed, not that they have no members; ‘any members’ contradicts the next clause.
findings.rationale: The joke is a three-person guild, not a guild with zero members that somehow also has three people.
findings.source: 평화 길드, 신생이라 인원이 없어. 길드장 포함 세 명이 전부지.

findings.defect: 고생하셨습니다 is deferential thanks for Choi’s labor; English ‘Good work’ is typically a superior’s appraisal and flips the porter-to-Team-Leader hierarchy.
findings.rationale: F-rank porter to C-rank Team Leader after the massacre; the line is subordinate courtesy, not a pat on the head.

findings.correction: He was a mid-rank Hunter, someone in a completely different league from a low-rank Hunter like me. / A mid-rank Hunter and the lowest-rank Hunter.
findings.current: He was a mid-level Hunter, someone in a completely different league from a low-rank Hunter like me. / A mid-level Hunter and the lowest-level Hunter.
findings.defect: Hunter 급 is rank; ‘level’ collides with System Lv. and is inconsistent with ‘low-rank’ in the same sentence.
findings.rationale: Binding: rank for Hunter classifications; Grade/Level are other systems.
findings.source: 그는 나 같은 하급 헌터와 격이 다른 ‘중급 헌터’니까. / 중급 헌터와 최하급 헌터.

findings.correction: Keep Dongdaemun and add a brief first-use footnote that it is Seoul’s major wholesale-market district.
findings.current: When I was a rookie, I’d splurged on it at an underground shop in Dongdaemun.
findings.defect: 동대문 is a first-use Korean place name with no ledger gloss or footnote.
findings.rationale: QA novel_name warning; rules require a footnote or established English on first unlisted local name.
findings.source: 초짜 시절, 동대문 지하 매장에서 큰맘 먹고 질렀더랬다.

findings.correction: Riding that momentum, Im Kkeokjeong swung his mace like a flyswatter, smashing limbs and crushing heads.
findings.current: Every time Im Kkeokjeong swung his mace like a flyswatter, limbs were smashed and heads were crushed.
findings.defect: Omits 기세를 탄 (riding the momentum after the shield hits).
findings.rationale: 기세 here is combat momentum, the listed aura/momentum sense, not disposable color.
findings.source: 기세를 탄 임꺽정이 철퇴를 파리채처럼 휘두를 때마다 팔다리가 아작 나고 머리통이 박살 난다.

findings.defect: 웃어? is a second-person challenge to Im, not a third-person observation.
findings.rationale: Pragmatic cue: Taekyung is incredulous at Im, which sets up 알아, 인마.

summary: Major fidelity hits: Im’s line on Choi liking equipment recognition is reversed into Choi lecturing; 인원이 없어 is rendered as zero members; 고생하셨습니다 is boss-to-subordinate ‘Good work.’ Minors: Dongdaemun lacks a first-use note, 기세를 탄 is dropped, and 웃어? is recast as third-person narration.
